message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the normalized primary product inventory during this 24-hour window.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only, combined, normalized, and deduplicated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-16 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-17 23:40 UTC (2026-10-17 05:10 IST through 2026-10-18 05:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

Fresh CVE and advisory records were checked against the monitored product names and obvious aliases. Candidates for unrelated products were excluded. Records involving monitored products that were made public before the cutoff were also excluded rather than reported as new. Source coverage included the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), vendor notices, CVE/NVD-indexed records, and CISA sources.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within the scan window. The newest MongoDB-family records found were outside the window. Sources: [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB Security Bulletins Archive](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/mongodb-security-bulletins/archive), and [GitHub Advisory Database - MongoDB](https://github.com/advisories?query=MongoDB+sort%3Apublished-desc).

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring and normal patch management for previously disclosed issues.
